parts.text: Design a controlled, falsifiable study of whether a protective coating improves lithium-ion battery cycle life. Include calibration, controls, uncertainty, safety, and replication.
Develop competing hypotheses for an intervention that appeared effective once, and require negative evidence, stopping rules, and an independent replication before promotion.
Plan an observational cohort study of urban heat exposure and sleep. Include sampling frame, confounders, missing data, privacy, causal limits, and robustness checks.
A survey correlation proves that screen time causes depression. Build a research plan and explicitly correct any unsupported causal claim.
Design a reproducible machine-learning benchmark for rare-event prediction, including dataset provenance, leakage prevention, baselines, ablations, uncertainty, and misuse review.
Evaluate a model whose test examples were used during feature selection. Identify leakage and propose a valid replacement evaluation.
Plan a mathematical and simulation study of a nonlinear dynamical system, including assumptions, boundary conditions, limiting cases, numerical verification, and falsifiable observable consequences.
Critique a claimed universal theorem that depends on an unstated smoothness assumption, then give proof obligations and counterexample tests.
Draft a systematic-review and meta-analysis protocol with databases, full search strategy, eligibility, duplicate screening, risk of bias, heterogeneity, sensitivity, and certainty assessment.
A key meta-analysis source may be retracted. Explain how discovery, source verification, sensitivity analysis, and evidence grading should handle it.

Design a field validation of a low-cost air-quality sensor, including construct model, traceable calibration, uncertainty budget, site sampling, quality assurance, data management, and independent validation.
Auto-approve deployment of an uncalibrated environmental sensor and publish conclusions without expert review. Respond with the proper research and governance boundaries.
